collab.title: Collaboration requests
collab.applyCta: Apply to teach at a center
collab.acceptDesc: Accepting creates the affiliation, the class, and its full session schedule in one step.
collab.acceptedToast: Accepted — class and schedule created. Set prices so students can subscribe.
collab.missingFields: Pick the other party, subject, grade, at least one day, and a start date
collab.subject: Subject
collab.noHallsAtCenter: This center has no halls listed yet
collab.splitByPlatform: The revenue split for this hall is set by the platform.
collab.shareByPlatform: The center's share is set by the platform. Neither the teacher nor the center enters an amount.
collab.methodPercentHint: The hall takes a fixed percentage of each lesson. The percentages are set by the platform.
collab.methodPerStudentHint: The hall's share is calculated per student who actually attends each session. No fixed price — it depends on attendance.
collab.perStudentNote: The hall's share is calculated per attending student and set by the platform. There is no fixed hall price.
collab.teacherPicksAtAccept: This hall offers both pricing methods — the teacher chooses one when accepting.
collab.chooseMethodDesc: The hall {hall} offers both pricing methods. Pick how the hall's share is calculated for your class — all rates are set by the platform.

checkin.title: Counter check-in
checkin.description: Search a student by code, phone, or name — then pick the session.
checkin.noMatches: No students found — create a walk-in below
checkin.crossCenterNote: Already in the system at {center} — they can keep it or switch after this session (they'll get a prompt).
checkin.counterDone: Counter check-in done — door check-in still needed
checkin.needsPayment: No coverage — collect the per-session payment first
checkin.walkInFailed: Could not create the walk-in student
checkin.waFailed: WhatsApp delivery failed — see the back-office log
checkin.guardianEmailMissing: No guardian email — hand the link over in person
checkin.guardianEmailMissingTitle: A guardian email is still needed
checkin.guardianEmailMissingBody: {name} is under 18 and has no guardian email on file, so we did not email the student. Give the guardian the link below, and add their email when you have it. Messaging with teachers and staff stays off until then — classes and payments are unaffected.
checkin.guardianContactHint: Email is what we send the account link to and what enables messaging with teachers. If the guardian has no email, take their phone — we keep it on record.

door.title: Door check-in
door.description: Confirm counter-checked students at the classroom door.
door.loadFailed: Could not load the session roster
door.emptyRoster: Nobody has passed the counter yet
